methodology: News items are taken from official organization announcements and dated press pages. The feed is sorted newest to oldest by publishedAt. RSS collection can append additional items from IAMSE and BMC Medical Education.

items.title: TGME posts a draft 2026 conference-at-a-glance program
items.summary: The Generalists in Medical Education published a draft program for its 4–6 November 2026 annual conference in Anaheim, California. The program is subject to change. Theme: New Teams for New Times: Collective Wisdom in Medical Education. The call for proposals closed 17 May 2026.
items.organization: The Generalists in Medical Education

items.title: LCME public hearing on AY 2028–29 Functions and Structure of a Medical School (Standards 1–6 & 8–12)
items.summary: The Liaison Committee on Medical Education holds a public hearing as the close of a 60-day written comment period on draft 2028–29 accreditation standards, excluding Standard 7 (commented separately). Facilitated by LCME Chair Charles J. Lockwood, MD, MHCM, and Chair-elect Donna Elliott, MD, EdD.
items.organization: Liaison Committee on Medical Education / AAMC

items.title: USMLE schedules review of the Step 3 passing standard
items.summary: The USMLE Management Committee will review the Step 3 passing standard at its November 2026 meeting, using standard-setting panels, stakeholder surveys, examinee-performance trends, and score-precision analyses. If changed, a new standard would apply to examinees testing on or after 1 January 2027.

items.title: Artificial intelligence in medical education: what helps, what’s risky
items.summary: Robert Wachter, MD (UCSF), discusses AI’s effects on learning, including productive friction, de-skilling, and never-skilling. He is scheduled to discuss the topic at Learn Serve Lead 2026 with OpenAI’s Karan Singhal and NYU’s Marc Triola, MD.
items.organization: Association of American Medical Colleges

items.title: IAMSE opens call for 2027 Focus Session abstracts
items.summary: IAMSE invited 90-minute Focus Session proposals for the 31st Annual Conference in Bellevue, Washington (5–8 June 2027), themed “Stronger Together: From Myths to Evidence in the Evolving Landscape of Health Science Education.” Submissions were due 1 September 2026.
items.organization: International Association of Medical Science Educators

items.title: Save the date: IAMSE 2027 in Bellevue, Washington
items.summary: IAMSE announced its 2027 Annual Conference for 5–8 June 2027 at the Hyatt Regency in Bellevue, near Seattle, with workshops, focus sessions, orals, posters, and the IAMSE Fellowship and Foundations course.
items.organization: International Association of Medical Science Educators

items.title: USMLE to move to designated testing dates beginning in 2028
items.summary: The USMLE program will reduce Step exam administrations to a total of 45 testing days a year starting in 2028, expanding dedicated testing-center capacity. The change is intended to strengthen exam security and score validity. Community sessions were planned for July–August 2026.
items.organization: United States Medical Licensing Examination

items.title: Burns and Roberts-Lieb named 2026 IAMSE career award recipients
items.summary: Christopher Burns (Wake Forest) received the Distinguished Career Award and Sol Roberts-Lieb (University of Maryland, Baltimore) the Early Career Award. Both were to be honored at the 30th Annual IAMSE Conference in June 2026.
items.organization: International Association of Medical Science Educators

items.title: AAMC and ELFI announce MedLoans borrower-benefit collaboration
items.summary: AAMC and ELFI (SouthEast Bank) launched a private loan option for MD students after federal legislation reduced available federal loans. ELFI’s EdMed product is the selected option for 2026–27, with an interest-rate discount for eligible borrowers.
items.organization: Association of American Medical Colleges

items.title: NBME opens 2026 Emerging Innovators and 2027 Stemmler grant cycles
items.summary: NBME invited proposals for Emerging Innovators Grants (due 15 June 2026, up to $25,000) and letters of intent for 2027 Stemmler Grants (due 29 June 2026, up to $150,000) focused on innovative and equitable assessment.
items.organization: National Board of Medical Examiners

items.title: LCME considers revisions to health-equity and structural-competency language
items.summary: Inside Higher Ed reported that the LCME was reviewing proposed curricular-standard changes that would reduce explicit requirements to teach structural competency and related topics, with revised standards proposed to take effect in 2027–28. The piece documents community pushback during the comment period.
items.organization: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (reported by Inside Higher Ed)

items.title: AAMC member schools recognized for advancing nutrition training
items.summary: HHS and the U.S. Department of Education recognized academic-medicine progress on nutrition education. AAMC had issued a November 2025 call to action and planned an April 2026 educator convening with the Teaching Kitchen Collaborative and NBME participation.
items.organization: Association of American Medical Colleges

items.title: AMEE names Van Nguyen recipient of the 2026 Research Grant
items.summary: AMEE awarded its 2026 Research Grant to Dr Van Nguyen for a realist economic evaluation of community-based mental health placements in urban and rural settings. Associate investigators include Jonathan Foo, Emiliana Guerra, Danielle Najm, Terry Haines, Luke Robinson, and Charlotte Rees.
items.organization: AMEE – The International Association for Health Professions Education

items.title: AMEE awards 2026 Faculty Development Research Grant to Maastricht team
items.summary: Lianne Loosveld (Maastricht University), with Eline Vanassche and Diana Dolmans, received the 2026 AMEE Faculty Development Research Grant to study how teacher identity relates to engagement in faculty development.
items.organization: AMEE – The International Association for Health Professions Education

items.title: AMEE announces 2026 MERCS Grant recipients in Sri Lanka and Pakistan
items.summary: Two AMEE grants for medical educators in resource-constrained settings were awarded: Madawa Chandratilake (University of Kelaniya, Sri Lanka) for a low-cost burnout-mitigation package for undergraduate healthcare students, and Bushra Mehboob (Khyber Medical University, Pakistan) for a study of culture in undergraduate accreditation in a postcolonial context.
items.organization: AMEE – The International Association for Health Professions Education

items.title: AMA announces recipients of USD 12 million precision education grant program
items.summary: The American Medical Association named 11 teams, spanning more than 80 institutions, as recipients of the Transforming Lifelong Learning Through Precision Education Grant Program. Each team receives USD 1.1 million over four years to use data and AI to personalize learning for medical students, residents, and practicing physicians.
items.organization: American Medical Association
